integrity: The arbitrary-dimension proof is self-contained. The finite exhaustive program is corroborating evidence only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a chosen natural basis in which each basis square has support size at most one.
It does not extend as stated to basis squares with two or more nonzero coordinates, where powers need not remain coordinate subspaces.
